# **DELIGHTFUL SMP**
Farmer's Delight on a Minecraft server for cozy fun!
## About
A cozy Minecraft server enhanced by Farmer's Delight and a few other mods for a relaxed playthrough. PvP is enabled but spawn killing and hostility won't be tolerated. Delightful is about making friends, having fun, and creating a memorable experience for everyone.
## Mods
Delightful SMP uses quite a few mods. These include Farmer's Delight (and some companion mods), Simple Voice Chat, Sit, Structory: Towers, VeinMiner, Traveler's Backpack, and Dungeons and Taverns (and many companion mods).
## Whitelist
To protect from bots and griefers, Delightful SMP has a Whitelist. If you want to join, email me at evanreames1@outlook.com with your username and I'll add you to the Whitelist. Please note that alt accounts are **not allowed**.
